notes.title: Summer Event 2023
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

The Summer season is here again, and to celebrate, the Summer bonus mission (Operation: Heatwave) is once again available for all players between June 5th and June 12th. This 10 wave mission finds the Vaders attempting to use their HEATR UFO to melt the polar icecaps with fireballs. In order to stop them you'll need to defeat pesky sunglasses wearing vaders as well as destroy the UFO itself.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37060761/1c08bd554bb2de3a4d9511b7e922b08083f93f98.png

In addition, you might find retro mode looking a little more summery than usual as the vaders don their sunglasses in Retro mode too. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37060761/e805142354d83443744ee029a767d9d1e833ddfb.jpg
Like the other seasonal event this bonus mission and the summer themed retro mode are only available for a limited time so don't miss your opportunity to complete the mission and unlock the in-game awards and steam achievements.

Finally to celebrate our the summer season we will once again be offering the Classified Projects DLC at a 25% discount, between June 5th and June 12th. This not only gives you access to a host of additional content such as experimental blasters and alternate shield options to use in any mission but also gives you all year round access to Operation: Bad Heatwave and the other 3 seasonal missions.

Enjoy Operation: Heatwave, try not to get sunburnt and whether you choose to pick up Classified Projects or not, I hope you have a great summer!

- Nutter

PS: If anyone from the UK is at Download Festival this weekend, feel free to say hi if you spot me!

notes.title: Spring Event 2023
notes.content:

notes.title: Christmas Event 2022
notes.content:

This not only gives you access to a host of additional content such as experimental blasters and alternate shield options to use in any mission but also gives you all year round access to Operation: Naughty List and the other 3 seasonal missions.

notes.title: Halloween Event 2022 (Steam Scream Fest)
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Halloween is upon us again (or soon will be) and to celebrate, the Halloween themed bonus mission (Operation: Nightmare) is once again available for all players between October 24th and November 1st. This 10 wave mission finds you trapped in a horrific nightmare where the earth has already fallen and a terrifying new breed of vader stalks the devastated planet. In order to survive the night and awake from this terror you'll need to face these new bloodthirsty vaders and defeat two terrifying and mission exclusive bosses, Vamp and the titular Nightmare.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37060761/c8ec261fe8b18f78fa314fc5efa058be398b5056.png

In addition, you might find retro mode looking a little bit spookier (and bloody) than usual. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37060761/aa166a35649112f5586145432f9366dbc4ee98bb.jpg
Like the other seasonal event this bonus mission and the halloween themed retro mode are only available for a limited time so don't miss your opportunity to complete the mission and unlock the in-game awards and steam achievements.

Finally to celebrate our favourite spooky season we will once again be offering the Classified Projects DLC at a 20% discount between Oct 25th and November 1st. This not only gives you access to a host of additional content such as experimental blasters and alternate shield options to use in any mission but also gives you all year round access to Operation: Nightmare and the other 3 seasonal missions.

Enjoy Operation: Nightmare and whether you choose to pick up Classified Projects or not, I hope you have a great halloween!

- Nutter
